correctness.rationale: Smoothness holds by disjoint partial derivatives of separable F and smooth G. Nontrivial Z stabilizers are exactly E (G=0 in P2) and F=0 three points in P1. Generic block projection to P1×P2 is a rational degree-three cube-root cover upstairs; Z acts transitively on the three scales, so Y is birational to P1×P2. Equivariant tangent charts give weights (1,1,0) along E and (1,1,1) at p_i; ages 2/3 and 1 distinguish noncanonical curve vs canonical nonterminal isolated points. No divisorial branch: K_X=pi* K_Y, -K_X=2H, H³=3, thus volume 8. Transfer H*(Y,Q)=H*(X,Q)^Z plus smooth cubic threefold b3=10, chi(E)+3=3 and trace(H3)=1 gives b3(Y)=4; H3 pure, h21=h12=2. This is an unrestricted argument for all smooth split cubics, not a numerical sample.
